venture.name: FreshCheck
venture.concept: Proposed smart lid and compatible container with automatic timer, traffic-light indicator, proposed gas sensor and app reminders.
venture.valueProposition: Help people remember stored leftovers with a simpler tracking routine; performance unvalidated.
venture.model: Physical product bundle; one-time purchase assumed
venture.operatingBasis: Home-based founder-led operation with outsourced engineering and assembly. No commercial office or full-time team assumed.
venture.websiteVerification: GitHub Pages API resolved this URL from the supplied repository; original source inspected, unchanged.

products.description: One proposed smart lid plus a compatible container.
products.features: Proposed automatic timer; planned app reminders; proposed indicator and sensor, performance unvalidated.
